title: Memorandum of Understanding with The Empyrean Cam Ranh Beach Resort
summary: Let’s Do It Vietnam and The Empyrean Cam Ranh Beach Resort took a significant first step towards sustainability with the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding. This agreement symbolizes the start of a strong partnership aimed at promoting sustainability within the resort, focusing on cleanliness, reducing environmental impact, and enhancing guest satisfaction.

Our mission is to ensure that Let’s Do It is recognized not only for World Cleanup Day but also as a movement for a generation of young people committed to bringing positive values to the community. This September also marks my six-year journey alongside Let’s Do It Vietnam and Let’s Do It Hanoi.
